inputs.checklistItemText: Project Information section or Fire/Domestic/Irrigation Demand Data table on AW General Info Sheet not completed (missing project info fields or any of: PSI, fire flow, WSFU, domestic demand, irrigation, velocities, LUEs)
inputs.question: Is there a "Project Information" or "Fire/Domestic/Irrigation Demand Data" table on this sheet? If yes, are all the following fields completed: PSI (pressure), fire flow GPM, WSFU (water supply fixture units), domestic demand GPM, irrigation demand GPM, velocities, and LUEs (living unit equivalents)?

output.reasoning: The agent is asking whether a table exists on the sheet and whether its fields are populated—this is a table-read and completeness check, not a drawing annotation inspection or measurement task.
